Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap and the attachments. A few clarifications from our side: 

- SSO: We need SAML-based SSO integration with our Okta instance (SCIM for provisioning would be nice but not required on day 1).
- KMS: Our security policy requires customer-managed keys. HSM-backed KMS is preferred for the most-sensitive data, but if BYOK via cloud KMS (customer project) is supported on Dedicated that may be acceptable. If HSM is only available on Private, please flag that explicitly.
- Logging: Regulatory team requires retention of logs (audit + request/response metadata) for up to 7 years. We need either the ability to export logs to our archival S3/GCS with retention policy enforced, or for Redwood to host long-term retention under appropriate controls.

Thanks Marissa — quick answers from a product/commercial perspective ahead of the deep-dive: 

- KMS / BYOK: Dedicated supports customer-managed keys via cloud KMS integrations (GCP KMS / AWS KMS) where the customer controls keys in their project/account (BYOK). For HSM-backed keys (FIPS 140-2 Level 3 or similar on a dedicated HSM) we typically require Private deployments or an HSM-as-a-service arrangement; this is because HSM-attested key material needs tighter isolation and control than our standard Dedicated pool provides. We'll document exact options and constraints for the deep-dive.

- Logging retention (7y): Two viable paths on Dedicated:
  1) Log forwarding: stream audit + request metadata to customer-owned S3/GCS with lifecycle rules for 7y retention (recommended for compliance).
  2) Redwood-managed long-term retention: we offer a compliance add-on to host long-term logs, but for multi-year immutable retention and auditability we generally recommend Private or explicit contractual controls (this option requires review and a commercial add-on).

- SSO: SAML SSO + SCIM provisioning are standard integrations for both Dedicated and Private; no blockers there.

Next steps: Vivek — can you join the Fri deep-dive and cover KMS connectivity/technical architecture? I'll prepare a short pricing delta summary (Dedicated baseline vs Private with HSM/compliance add-ons) and share ahead of the call.

Rishi Malhotra
